read.thesis: Q4 adj. EBITDA fell to $505M on weak US phosphate demand and rising sulfur costs, with phosphate inventories built and 2026 phosphate volume guided at or above 7.0Mt against a tightening market led by China export curbs.

capex.quote: Mosaic expects 2026 capital expenditures to be approximately $1.5 billion, reflecting higher spending for gypstack and clay settling areas.

triggers.label: China phosphate exports absent
triggers.quote: Phosphate markets have tightened as China exports remain largely absent following the announcement of extended phosphate export restrictions

triggers.label: Finished inventory build $428M
triggers.quote: a $428 million increase in finished product inventories
triggers.highlight: $428 million increase in finished product inventories

triggers.label: SSP curtailment ~30% of Brazil output
triggers.quote: temporarily curtailed SSP production at the Fospar JV and Araxa site, which together account for approximately 30% of Mosaic's production in Brazil

triggers.label: Q1 DAP guided $640-670/t
triggers.quote: Mosaic expects first quarter sales volumes of 1.7 to 1.9 million tonnes with DAP prices averaging $640 to $670 per tonne on an FOB basis
triggers.highlight: DAP prices averaging $640 to $670 per tonne

triggers.label: Brazil credit constraints persist
triggers.quote: Fourth-quarter sales volumes and distribution margin per tonne were impacted by intensified competition and tightening credit conditions.

guidance.quote: 2026 production volumes are expected to be at or above 7.0 million tonnes
In 2026, Mosaic expects total potash production of approximately 9 million tonnes
Mosaic expects 2026 capital expenditures to be approximately $1.5 billion
first quarter segment adjusted EBITDA is expected to be below $50 million
targets net sales to approximately double compared with 2025

red_flags.label: Inventory build and weak operating cash flow
red_flags.quote: Due to weak demand, the inventory build accelerated in the fourth quarter resulting in cash flow from operations of $(56) million.

red_flags.label: Free cash flow negative for 2025
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow (1) was $(535) million in 2025, compared to $47 million in 2024

red_flags.label: Brazil credit stress and SSP margin squeeze
red_flags.quote: A sharp increase in sulfur prices late in the quarter, absent mitigating actions could materially impact production margins in 2026.
